title: Predictive Maintenance — Machine-Specific AI Ecosystem
summary: A machine-specific predictive maintenance platform that trains dedicated GANs (HC-GAN) and ML models for individual industrial machines like motors, pumps, and robots to generate synthetic operational data and predict failures. The repository lists sdv and ctgan in requirements.txt for synthetic data generation, but no code calling either library appears in the harvested evidence.
needs: No pattern hits in code; repository appears to use a custom 'HC-GAN' rather than SDV/CTGAN despite listing both as dependencies — cannot confirm actual usage.
